tooltip.memfixer.lazy_dfu: Bypasses eager precomputation of DataFixerUpper schema rules during bootstrap to eliminate startup stall and heap overhead.
tooltip.memfixer.optimize_unifont: Bypasses eager loading of unused CJK unifont glyphs for non-Asian languages, loading glyphs on demand.
tooltip.memfixer.reclaim_post_launch: Schedules a non-blocking post-initialization memory sweep and compaction once the title screen stabilizes.
tooltip.memfixer.reap_textures: Frees CPU-side native pixel buffers once static textures are uploaded to GPU VRAM.
tooltip.memfixer.compact_blockstates: Compacts BlockState neighbour transition lookup tables from Guava Tables to memory-dense flat arrays.
tooltip.memfixer.deduplicate_shapes: Deduplicates VoxelShape face slices and merges sturdy face boolean arrays into shared canonical masks.
tooltip.memfixer.optimize_panorama: Reduces TitleScreen panorama overdraw to single-pass and applies real-time frame pacing.
tooltip.memfixer.deduplicate_quads: Interns duplicate model BakedQuad instances into canonical references across block and item models.
tooltip.memfixer.deduplicate_conditions: Deduplicates multipart model state predicates and model pairs into canonical shared singletons.
tooltip.memfixer.intern_resources: Maps identical ResourceLocation namespaces and paths to canonical string pool entries to minimize duplicate string allocations.
tooltip.memfixer.optimize_chunk_storage: Replaces empty and uniform chunk zero-bit storage with canonical singletons and eliminates threading detector synchronization overhead.
tooltip.memfixer.enable_logging: Outputs detailed diagnostic, deduplication, and memory metrics to the console and game log.
tooltip.memfixer.deduplicate_tags: Interns duplicate Set<TagKey> and List<Holder> collections across registry entries into shared canonical instances.
tooltip.memfixer.deduplicate_ingredients: Interns duplicate Ingredient instances and item arrays into shared canonical singletons across all crafting recipes.
tooltip.memfixer.deduplicate_state_defin: Interns duplicate ImmutableSortedMap property maps across block and fluid state definitions into shared canonical singletons.
tooltip.memfixer.deduplicate_aabb_cache: Caches unmodifiable AABB lists on VoxelShapes and interns duplicate bounding box singletons to eliminate allocation churn during raycasts and collisions.
